prompt: Which plan would be most appropriate for Tom’s welcome?
promptZh: Tom 的開場致詞採用哪個方案最合適？

options.text: Thank Lani by name with the other volunteers and direct requests for early entry to the staffed desk.
options.zh: 公開點名感謝拉妮與其他志工，並請有提早進場需求的人聯絡服務櫃檯。
options.whyZh: 提早進場確實要找櫃檯；但拉妮用「等疊椅子時再謝我」婉轉表示個人致謝留到餐後，不必在開場點名。

options.text: Thank the volunteers together, direct early-entry requests to the staffed desk, and thank Lani separately later.
options.zh: 開場一起感謝志工，請有提早進場需求的人聯絡服務櫃檯，之後再個別向拉妮致謝。
options.whyZh: 拉妮想把個人致謝留到疊椅子時。她提到找到鑰匙不等於值班，是要避免來賓下週仍找她開門；櫃檯保管鑰匙，也能安排課程之外的進場。

options.text: Thank the volunteers together, direct early-entry requests to the leaders named on the signup cards, and thank Lani separately later.
options.zh: 開場一起感謝志工，請要提早進場的人找報名卡上的帶領人，之後再個別向拉妮致謝。
options.whyZh: 集體致謝、稍後個別感謝符合拉妮的意思；但報名卡上的帶領人答覆活動內容，不負責安排課前開門。

options.text: Thank Lani by name with the other volunteers and direct requests for early entry to the leaders named on the signup cards.
options.zh: 公開點名感謝拉妮與其他志工，並請要提早進場的人找報名卡上的帶領人。
options.whyZh: 個人致謝應留到疊椅子時。報名卡上的名字可供詢問活動，真正保管鑰匙並安排課前進場的是服務櫃檯。

explanationZh: 拉妮想把個人致謝留到疊椅子時。她提到找到鑰匙不等於值班，是要避免來賓下週仍找她開門；櫃檯保管鑰匙，也能安排課程之外的進場。
evidence: One guest has already asked her whether she can let the craft group in early next week. / Our craft signup cards name the person leading each class, for questions about the activity. / The staffed desk keeps the key and can arrange entry outside the class hours. / I asked Lani if you could mention her when you thank the people who got the hall ready. / I’ll take mine when we’re stacking the chairs. / Finding a key doesn’t make you the one on duty.

vocabulary.note: 指輪到某人負責某項工作，不等於曾經臨時幫忙。
